hints.title: Single Character Conversion Consistency
hints.text: Every occurrence of character c in str1 must map to the exact same character in str2. One character cannot transform into two different letters.

hints.title: Identical String Trivial Case
hints.text: If str1 already equals str2, zero transformations are needed, returning true immediately.

hints.title: Alphabet Saturation Bottleneck
hints.text: If str2 uses all 26 lowercase English letters and str1 does not match str2, at least one conversion cycle cannot be unraveled without a spare temporary character. Return false if unique letters in str2 equal 26.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating transformation steps step-by-step is intractable due to exponential graph permutations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking mapping determinism and alphabet fullness takes linear inspection time and O(1) space bounded by alphabet 26.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that a mapping cycle requires a free temporary character, which requires distinct characters in str2 < 26.
complexity.notes: Constant auxiliary space bounded by 26 lowercase letters.
